mapper.insert: insert into sys_oauth_client (client_id, client_name, redirect_uris, create_time) values (#{clientId}, #{clientName}, #{redirectUris}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: update sys_oauth_client set last_used_at = #{usedAt} where client_id = #{clientId}
mapper.delete: delete from sys_oauth_client where coalesce(last_used_at, create_time) < #{before} and not exists ( select 1 from sys_user_access_token t where t.client_id = sys_oauth_client.client_id and t.revoked_at is null and (t.expires_at is null or t.expires_at > #{now}) )
